title: MrMexican
description: A client thats use on CosmicPrisons with QOL features
body:
**Mexican — Cosmic Prisons Companion**
A lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that makes life on Cosmic Prisons smoother. Browse your player vaults from anywhere, ping locations to your gang, keep an eye on cooldowns and events with clean draggable HUDs, and tweak it all from one simple in-game menu. No setup required — install it, hop on, and it just works.

Client-side • Fabric 1.21.11 • Lunar Client

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

📦 **Player Vaults** (Better PV)
See every player vault at once in a scrollable grid — just type /pv
Search for an item across all your vaults instantly
Favorite a page and get live side-by-side thumbnails while a vault is open
Remembers vault contents per account and per planet (Celestial / Aether)
Works with renamed vaults ("Pets", "Armor", etc.), not just numbered ones

📍 **Pings & Waypoints**
Ping a spot and your whole gang sees a beacon beam + label through walls
Reads incoming gang/truce pings automatically
Fully customizable beams — color, size, opacity, solid or rainbow, text scale
Ping icons: player faces for player pings, item icons for meteors/merchants
Pulse support: auto-pings every meteorite from /pulse
PrisonBreak waypoints: auto-marks treasure chests when they're revealed

📊 **Draggable HUDs**
A clean, fully movable/resizable HUD layer (/pickle hud to arrange):

Cooldowns for /jet, /eat, /fix, trinkets, and more
Satchel fill levels, Page Chest counts, Inventory & Armor info
Event tracker — merchants, bandits, meteors, and upcoming server events
PrisonBreak enchants, Stronghold lockout timer, Jam Timer, Gang Points, Mining Level

⚙️ **Quality of Life**
Item Overlay — compact value text on items (energy, $ notes, gear level, dust %, page %)
Texture Pack — custom visuals for pages, books, bandit boxes, boosters & more
Book Detail — full enchant info on books
Chat Buttons — one-click Public/Gang/Ads switching, remembered per planet
Held Item Scale / Player Size — visual personalization
Peaceful Mining — mine the block behind a player who steps into your crosshair

🔔 **Notifications & Safety**
Chat Notifications — Skytils-style popups on your custom trigger words
Message alerts — a sound when someone DMs you
Ban Panel — live punishment feed; slides in a card whenever someone is warned/muted/banned

🎛️ **One simple menu**
Open everything with /pickle — tidy category columns (QoL / HUD / Ping / Mining) you can drag, search, and bind to keys
